correctness.rationale: The exact support bound for triples and the signs of induced simplex orientations yield a reduced Lefschetz sum. Boolean inversion over permutation cycles gives Phi(U)=(-1)^c(1-a+C(a,2)-b). Complementing supports of codimension less than three gives the displayed quartic; the parity factor is sign(sigma). The cited 2018 homology-concentration theorem makes the trace the unique top homology character. Pieri horizontal-strip interlacing and Frobenius induced-character evaluation prove the three Specht constituents. An extracted standalone Python checker exhaustively agrees with simplicial Lefschetz traces for all 15 and 22 classes at n=7,8 and independent Murnaghan–Nakayama character identities for all classes at n=7..11. These computations are checks, not replacements for the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The ordinary triple-Kneser neighborhood complexes are canonical high-symmetry topological spaces with established but nonequivariant sphere-wedge classification. The new infinite-family theorem identifies all rational irreducible constituents, proves multiplicity-freeness, gives a trace polynomial depending only on one- and two-cycles, and determines the absence of S_n and A_n fixed homology. These are structural equivariant invariants not recoverable from Betti numbers; the statement is mathematically natural and not an arbitrary finite parameter increment.
